tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'khor lo sdom pa khro bo rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba rdo rje

he ru ka'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ oṃ na mo sambha rā ya/ 'khor lo bde mchog khro bo rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba rdo rje hūṃ mdzad he ru ka'i sgrub thabs/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdo rje can 'di dus las rab grol mchog tu dul ba'i rang bzhin te/ /'gro rnams mun pa mthar byed rab tu che ba'i nang gi 'od zer ni/ /rtag tu 'char ba rang gi rig ma dang 'dus bdud bzhi 'joms dpa' bo/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal bde ba'i rol pa 'gro ba'i snying la 'jug par mdzod/ /sdom pa'i rgyud rgyal dngos grub kyi/ /chu gter 'di ni chu gter bzhin/ /mchog tu rgya che gting yang zab/ /ji ltar rgya mtsho'i 'gram dag kyang*/ /rkyal bas tshugs min de bzhin rin chen 'byung gnas 'di'i/ /sbyor ba re re'ang tshu rol mthong ba'i blos mi spyod/ /'on kyang dkar po'i blo yis rnam 'byed rdo rje can/ /deng bdag snying la zhugs snyam 'di la blo mig thob/ /de ltar na gzu bor gnas pas mnyan pa'i rigs so/ /'dir dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa shrī he ru ka rdo rje khro bo hūṃ mdzad kyi rnal 'byor la sogs pa khro bo bcu'i bka'i 'khor los sdang ba dang ma rungs pa'i sems can phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid thogs pa med par 'joms pa'i sbyor ba dang sngags dang rgyud 'di nyid kyis las grub par bya ba/ dang po'i las can la sogs pa gang zag bzhis so sor bya ba ni/ ji snyed cig bshad pa las/ nye bar mkho ba cung zad cig brjod na/ ting nge 'dzin gyis bsrung zhing phyir zlog gi sbyor ba dang*/ khro bo rnams kyi bsnyen pa dang*/ phyir zlog gi 'khrul 'khor dang*/ zhal bzhi pa'i 'khrul 'khor las tshogs dang*/ de rnams nyid kyis nges pa nang du bstan pa'o/ /bsrung ba bsnyen pa zlog 'khor dang*/ /las tshogs dang ni rdzogs rim mo/ /dang po sgom pa'i rnal 'byor gyis bsrung zlog kyang*/

rgyas pa dang*/ bar ma dang*/ bsdus pa'i dbye bas rnam pa mang por 'gyur ba las/ re shig 'khor lo sdom pa la dga' ba'i sngags pa las dang po pa rnams la nye bar mkho bar snang bas/ man ngag las kyang 'byung ba/ rgyud don las kyang mi 'da' ba kho nar bsrung 'khor rgyas pa nyid tshig zor yang pa'i sgo nas thog mar brjod la/ rgyas bsdus kyi 'dor len ci rigs pa dag ni phyis bshad par bya'o/ /de yang*/ oṃswa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ/ oṃ shūn+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba atma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi la hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa rnams shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing kha hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bhruṃ las bka'i 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa g.yas bskor du mgyogs par 'khor ba/ rdo rje 'bar ba'i sprin phyogs bcur 'phro ba/ de'i lte bar paṃ las sna tshogs chu skyes dang*/ raṃ las nyin mor byed pa'i gdan la/ thog tha med pa'i sems kyis rang snang hūṃ dkar po las/ bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ dpa' bo bde ba'i go 'phangs la bzhugs pa/ zhal gsum pa/ rtsa zhal dang sku lus dag pa'i shel dang ston zla ltar dkar zhing zhi ba/ g.yas ser g.yon ljang ba'i zhal gnyis rnam par 'gyur ba/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis ka pā la dang kha ṭwaṃ ga bsnams pa/ thod pa'i cod pan dang rgyan thams cad pa/ mtshan dpes spras pa'i sku/ g.yas rkyang gi stabs can/ 'dod chags rdo rje'i 'od 'phrengs 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor na rol pa/ hūṃ las byung ba'i thabs kyis rdo rje/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang āḥlas shes rab kyi padma/ padma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa/ snying po'i bu gar byāṃ dang dyaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ rdo rje pad mar bskyod pa'i dga' ba'i sgra dang*/

thugs ka'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad mi bskyod pa khro bo bcu dang bcas pa'i rnam par bkug ste/ zhal du zhugs lha mo'i padmar babs pa/ hūṃ bcu gcig las zhe sdang rdo rje he ru ka khro bo bcu dang bcas par gyur/ mi bskyod pa thugs kar drangs hūṃ zhes phyir phyung*/ snang ba'i sems can thams cad tshar bcad/ rdo rje khro bo'i sa la bkod/ rang la thim pas bdag nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed hūṃ mdzad he ru kar gyur pa ni/ sku mdog mthing nag khro bo 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrug pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs par mdzad pa/ gdon bgegs thams cad za bar byed pa'i zhal gsum dbus mthing kha/ g.yas ser/ g.yon ljang ba/ gsum ka'ang lhag par khros pa'i gad rgyangs can/ me ltar 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i spyan gsum gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ zhal gdangs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ glog 'phreng lta bu'i smin rdzi g.yo ba'i khro gnyer bsdus pa/ thod pa'i dum bus 'og pag dang*/ phyag rgya drug dang*/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ mi mgo'i me tog gi do shal can/ stag lpags kyis smad dkris pa/ rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgyas rdo rje dang rdo rje dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pas rang snang gi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ pad nyi la g.yas brkyang bas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma mnan pa'o/ khro bo bcu rnams thugs kar drangs/ hūṃ thugs ka nas phyir spros/ phyogs mtshams kyi rtsibs brgyad kyi steng dang*/ steng 'og gi rtsibs brgyad kyi nang la cung zad ma reg pa rnams su pad nyi dang phyogs skyong ba bcu'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ shar du rdo rje gtum po sngon po sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum pa/ byang du rdo rje nyi ma me ser po ser nag ljang ba'i zhal gsum pa/ nub tu rdo rje gtsug tor dmar po dmar nag ljang ba'i zhal gsum pa/ lhor rdo rje 'khyil pa ljang khu ljang dkar ser ba'i zhal gsum/

mer rdo rje gnod sbyin dud ka dud ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ bden bral du rdo rje dus dmar po dmar ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ rlung du rdo rje stobs po che nag po nag ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum/ dbang ldan du rdo rje 'jigs rung sngon po sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal gsum pa mi g.yo ba/ de rnams phyag dang po gnyis cang te'u dang rdo rje dril bu bsnams pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba dkar po dkar nag ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag dang po gnyis 'khor lo dang dril bu/ 'og tu rdo rje sa 'og mig sman ltar gnag pa/ nag ser ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag dang po gnyis rtse gsum dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ de thams cad rgyan dang cha lugs gtso bo lta bu/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag drug gi lhag ma g.yas gnyis na lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rtsa ba'i phyag gis rang snang gi shes rab la 'khyud pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /khro bo bcu ni sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung dang*/ 'gog pa dang*/ lam dang*/ zad pa dang*/ mi skye ba dang*/ kun rdzob dang*/ pha rol sems dang*/ chos dang*/ rjes su shes pa ste/ rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du'o/ /de thams cad kyi snying gar oṃ oṃ ha/ zhes pa nas/ tsaṇḍa ki'i ngo bo/ zhes pa'i bar ram/ yang na sgrub thabs ltar zhal phyag rdzogs pa'i go cha bkod/ dpral par oṃ dkar po sogs rdo rje gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer mu mtha' med pas khro bo'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs phaiṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ye shes kyi 'khor lo sad/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ chu gnyis dang nyer spyod lnga 'bul/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dpal bde mchog gi sgrub thabs bzhin chus dbang bskur bas/ hūṃ mdzad la rdo rje sems dpa'/ rdo rje gtum po la rnam snang*/

nyi ma la rin 'byung*/ gtsug tor la 'od dpag med/ 'khyil pa la don grub/ gzhan thams cad la mi bskyod pa'am/ yang na/ gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu brgyan/ gzhan rnams la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ krodha rā dza sa pa ri wa ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ pra dya puṣpe/ nas/ shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags brjod nas/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs thams cad med par gyis shig ces khro bo rnams la bka' bgos pas/ khro bo re re las phur bu'i khro bo zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis pa rtsa zhal sngo/ g.yas ser po dud kha g.yon dmar po ljang khu/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ rang snang gi rig mar sbyor ba de 'og gnyis lha chen po'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs/ lhag ma g.yas bzhis kha ṭwāṃ ga lcags kyu/ tshangs mgo gri gug g.yon bzhis thod pa/ zhags pa/ cang te'u/ gri gug mi mgo'i cod pan dang do shal/ phyag rgya drug dang*/ klu mtha' yas dang rnam rgyal gyis brgyan pa/ rab tu khros pa/ khro bo'i mtshan nyid rdzogs pa/ zhabs gcig pu mdung rtse lta bu'i phur bur gyur pa/ gang gis kyang bzod glags med pa'i me dpung 'ur 'ur 'bar ba can te/ steng zhal ni steng gi khro bo stag dang*/ 'og ni byi ba'i gdong*/ shar nas phyogs g.yon bskor dang*/ me nas mtshams g.yas bskor gyis rta gdong dkar po/ glang po/ byi ba/ seng ge khyi dang*/ 'ug pa/ phag dang*/ khra'i gdong can no/ / yang hūṃ bzhi pa lan gnyis brjod cing*/ sdigs mdzub se gol phyogs bcur gdab cing*/ shar dang steng du khwa gdong ma sngo ba/ byang du 'ug gdong ma ljang ba/ nub dang 'og tu khyi gdong ma dmar ba/ lhor phag gdong ma ser ba/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma sngo ser phyed pa/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo ser dmar phyed pa/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma dmar ljang phyed pa/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma ljang sngon phyed pa/ yang na thams cad dmar mor man ngag las 'byung ba'ang rung ngo*/

/thams cad kyang lang tsho gzhon nu dregs shing khros pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje tho ba/ g.yon sngar spros pa'i phur bu'i khro bo re re bzung ba las/ pho nya dpag tu med pa spros te/ bgegs kun tshar bcad/ oṃ badzra aṅku sha ya a karṣa ya hūṃ/ oṃ badzra pā sha bandha hūṃ/ oṃ badzra ka li ta sdza ba hūṃ/ oṃ badzra muṣti gh-ihṇa hūṃ/ lcags kyu dang zhags pa la sogs pa mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa'i pho nya rnams kyis phyogs bcu'i bgegs ma lus pa 'dus pa phyogs skyong bcur gyur pa rnams rdo rje lcags kyus snying gar btab/ rdo rje zhags pas bcings/ mtshon cha thams cad kyis bsdigs/ khu tshur gyis bzungs nas/ 'khor lo'i rtse mo dang nye ba'i phyi rol du hūṃ las byung ba'i khron pa gru gsum pa zab mo/ phyogs mtshams brgyad dang*/ shar gyi shar dang*/ nub kyi nub na gnas pa ste bcu po rnams su bcug ma mo brgyad po rnams kyis lugs 'byung dang lugs zlog gi rim pas/ de rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus btab/ oṃ gha gha ghā tā ya ghā tā ya sarba duṣtan phaṭa/ ki lā ya ki lā ya sarba pā baṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badzra ki lā ya badzra dha ra ya dzñā pa ya ti sarba bighna kā ya wāktsitta badzra kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod/ phur bu rnams lugs 'byung dang lugs zlog gi rim pas tho bas brdung*/ oṃ badzra muṅga ra badzra ki lā ya a ko ṭwā ya sha hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga lte ba gsang ba rkang pa rnams su phug ste rdo rje'i sa gzhi la sbrags pas bgegs rnams lus g.yo ba med/ dag rlung rgyu ba med pa sems rtog pa thams cad chad nas/ bde ba chen po de bzhin nyin dang ro gcig tu gyur/ yang zhal bzhi pa'i sngags brjod pas/ sngags rnams 'od zer 'phro ba/ gser gyi sa gzhi nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten la thug pa'i lus che zhing 'bar ba'i 'od zer las/ skad cig gis grub pa ni/

rdo rje'i ra ba gru bzhi pa steng du rdo rje'i gur/ de gnyis kyi mtshams su bla bre/ phyi rol du rdo rje rtse lnga'i mde'u can gyi mda' dra srid rtse'i bar du khyab pa/ de thams cad kyi phyi nang kun rdo rje me ri sgra drag po dang bcas pa bskal pa 'jig pa'i dus kyi me dpung lta bu gnod byed thams cad kyis bltar yang mi bzod par gyur/ de dang dus mnyam du sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la thug par sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ oṃ me dhi ni badzri bha ba badzra bandha hūṃ/ oṃ badzra pra ka ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badzra pañtsa ra hūṃ paṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badzra pī tā na hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badzra sa ra dzā la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ oṃ badzra dzwa la a na lārka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ slar yang pho nya mo rnams kyis ma rungs pa thams cad tshar bcad de/ rdo rje'i rwa ba la thim pas chu chu la brdabs pa'i zegs ma phyir 'phros pa ltar/ rdo rje dang padma dang*/ 'khor lo'i rwa ba rnams su gyur/ oṃ badzra pra ka ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ padma pra ka ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra pra ka ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas 'og nas 'byung ba'i khro bo bzhi spros shing*/ khro bo rnams kyi bzlas pa bya ba'am/ yang na man ngag gi tshul las mngon brjod drug cu pa'i skabs las 'byung ba ltar 'dir blangs te/ 'di ltar/ rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyis hūṃ zhes brjod pas skad cig gis rab khros hūṃ mdzad zhal gsum pa las brgyad par gyur te/ drag shul can gyi gzugs rtsa zhal dang sku mdog dus sprin ltar gnag pa/ g.yas gsum dkar sngo ser ba/ g.yon gsum sngo dkar ser ba steng zhal dmar po/ phyag bcu drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje dril bus thugs kar 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa gnyis khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya dpral par 'jog pa/ lhag ma g.yas pas thod pa/ ral gri/

'khor lo/ tho ba/ cang te'u rnams dang*/ g.yon rnams kyis kha ṭwāṃ galcags kyu/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ rin po che/ mdung rtse gsum pa dang bcas pa'i tshangs pa'i mgo bo rnams 'dzin pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis mi'i pags pa steng du 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa thugs ka'i hūṃ las khro bo bzhi dus gcig tu spros pa ni/ 'dod rgyal sngon po sngo ser ljang ba/ g.yas gnyis pas tho ba/ dbyug sngon ljang khu ljang ser g.yas gnyis pas be con/ stobs chen dmar po dmar ser ljang*/ g.yas gnyis pas tri shu la/ mi g.yo mgon po dud kha dud ser ljang ba/ g.yas gnyis pas ral gri/ thams cad kyi dang po gnyis 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi phyag rgya dpral par 'jog pa g.yon gnyis pas dril bu dang bcas pa'i thod pa/ tha ma gnyis rdo rje gyen du gsor zhing kha ṭaṃ ga bsnams pa/ bar pa gnyis kyis rang snang gi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ bdud bzhi zhabs kyis gnon pa rnams spros/ sdang ba thams cad tshar bcad/ bar chad bsrung ba'i las mdzad/ yang zhal bzhi pa brjod/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad spros/ sngar bzhin las mdzad/ oṃ kha badzra dhṛ ka badzra hūṃ ka ra badzra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa badzra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra dzā lā na lārka badzra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzro ṣṇe ṣa badzra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kuṇḍa li badzra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra yaksha badzra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kā li badzra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra mahā bā la badzra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃbadzra bhi ṣa ṇa badzra hūṃ phaṭa/

zhes khro bo bcu gcig dang*/ gtso bo nyid kyi gsang sngags/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa pā ya gṛhṇa pā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ auṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badzri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes skad gsang mthon pos bzla bar bya'o/ /gal te phyir zlog bya bar 'dod na hūṃ zhes brjod pas khro bo thams cad cher 'khrugs te zhal phyir gzigs/ 'khor lo g.yon du drag tu 'khor/ khro bo thams cad las pho nya dpag tu med pa dang*/ khyad par rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ gi 'od kyis gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba bskul/ gnyis ka las khro mo bcu'am/ khro bo bzhi'i sprin dpag tu med pa spros/ gdug pa thams cad dang*/ sgrub bya bkugame rlung gi steng du bcing pa lngas bcings mgo mjug ljog der bzhag pa/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyis phye mar gtubs/ mes bsregs pa'i thal ba rlung gis gtor bar bsam/ gang yang skyes bu gzhan gyi phyir ni/ sgrub bya'i snying ga'i hūṃ gi nā da dam/ 'khor lo'i lte bar chud par bsgom mo/ /sngags 'di ni rang dang gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba gnyis pa'i rgyu mtshan rnams gnad 'di gcig pus rtogs nus pas 'dab bzhi'i rim pas rtsa lag bzhi/ bde ba chen po'i gnas na gnas/ /zhes pa'i tshig rkang gnyis po 'di kho nas kyang*/ dus 'khor sogs kyi rgyud sde mang po la nges pa ster ba 'di ni ngo mtshar che'o/ /man ngag gi gzhung bya ba/ rgyud don gyi mdud pa 'khrol nus pa 'di lta bu dgos kyi/ man ngag dang rgyud bshad rgyab 'gal du 'gro ba dang*/ grub thob kyi gsung yin zer nas sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang 'gal ba mang po dag snang ste/ rtsod dus kyi tha ma 'dir/ skal med rnams kyi snying la ni shin tu 'phrod kyang*/ zab don gyi skal ba can blo gros mchog rnams kyis ni/ mdzod phugs mi gtsang bas bkang ba dang 'dra bar mthong ngo*/

/gsum pa ni e waṃ sa bon blangs nas ni/ /padma'i me tog kha bye bar/ /bung ba'i gzugs kyis rab dga' ba'i/ /dpa' bo sbrang rtsi mnom par byed/ /ces pa ste/ 'di la shung ke lo tsā ba grags rgyal gyis/ e waṃ yi ge'i sa bon len/ /chu skyes kyi ni me tog la/ /sbrang rtsir byed pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /rab dga'i dbang po sbrang rtsi mnom/ /zhes 'don pa go bde zhing brjod sla ba tsam snang ngo*/ /'di'i don 'grel par/ e waṃ pha ma'i sa bon blangs pa dang*/ padma mngal gnas dang*/ bung ba dri za dang*/ rab dga' dkar dmar gyi dbus su sems rgyal ba la 'chad kyang de gzhung gi don du mi snang ngo*/ /e waṃ ni gong du bshad pa ltar gyi/ sgra gcan dang dus me yin zhing*/ der yang skabs 'dir bde ba'i phyogs nas bstan pas/ nyi ma gcig gis bsang bar mdzod cig zhes sogs dmod tshig brjod la/ rang gi lag mthil sna tshogs rdo rjer bsam la thal mo brdabs pas/ dgra bgegs skad cig gis thal bar brlag par bsam/ khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ / zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams/ /'dul dka' 'dul byed sogs brjod gal te thun mtshams su 'di nyid ched kyi byas pa yin na/ mchod bstod gtor ma dbul ba sogs bya'o/ /sngon gyi bod mkhas pa rnams phyir bzlog la/ steng dang dbus kyi khro bo brje bar bzhed de/ gzhan dang mthun pas legs mod/ 'on kyang 'di skor gyi rgyud dang rgya gzhung khungs ma rnams las ma bshad cing*/ gsang 'dus dang*/ rdo rje gur sogs dang 'di cung mi 'dra'o/ /de ltar brjes na gtso bo 'pho ba'i gnad/ bsrung bya sba ba'i gnad/ lha'i rnam pa'i gnad/ 'khor lo 'khor ba'i gnad/ sngags zla ba'i gnad ces bod snga ma rnams kyi brda chad du gnad lnga zhes gsungs pa de yang tshang bar mngon/ spyir de rnams kyi man ngag rgya gar gyi slob dpon tshad ldan gyis bshad pas/ tha snyad ni rgya gzhung las 'byung ngo zhes ngal bas sgrub mi dgos shing 'grub dka'o/

/rdo rje gur du ni khro bo bcu'i las tshogs kyi gtsug tor gyi skabs 'khor lo'i lte bar khro bo sgom nas phyir bzlog bya bar gsungs/ le'u bcu gnyis par dkyil 'khor gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung 'khor gsungs pa rnams man ngag gi sdebs pa las/ gtso bo 'pho ba'i tshul 'byung la/ 'dir ni de ltar med pas/ gtso bo spo ba yang mi dgos so zhes rig par bya'o/ /gzhan yang rdo rje rwa gur sngon du bsgom nas/ 'khor lo phur gdab sogs phyis byed pa yang lugs gzhan te/ dang po nag po lugs dang mthun la/ 'di ni lū yi pa dang mthun zhing 'di gnyis ka'ang shin tu rgyas pa'o/ /gnyis/ yang phur bu'i khro bo dang hūṃ mdzad phyi ma khro bo bzhi dang bcas pa bor ba snga ma lta bu dang*/ gsum/ lwa ba'i zhal snga nas kyi 'grel par bstan pa ltar/ hūṃ bzhi pas khro mo bcu spros/ phur gdab byas/ rwa gur sogs sngags tshan drug gis bkod/ de'i dbus su 'khor lo rdo rje sems dpa' dang bcas pa bskyed/ rdor sems yongs su gyur pa las/ khro bo bcu gcig skad cig gis bskyed pa ni/ nag po pa'i zhabs dang 'brel la/ bzhi/ rwa gur sogs bskyed la/ 'khor lo khro bo bcu gcig dang bcas pa bsgoms/ hūṃ bzhi pas khro mo spros nas/ phur gdab sogs byed pa ni nya lto ba'i zhabs dang mthun no/ /lnga/ mngon brjod du bstan pa yang 'di dang mthun te/ 'on kyang phur gdab ni hūṃ bzhi pas bka' bsgos nas/ khro bo bcus byed pa yin te/ 'di gsum la rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las khro bo brgyad spros/ gtso bo hūṃ mdzad du bsgyur/ de dang dus mnyam du steng 'og bskyed pa ste/ mngon brjod dngos bstan du khro bo brgyad spro zhes pa las/ ji ltar spro mi gsal lo/ /drug /yang rdo rje sems dpa' hūṃ mdzad du bsgyur nas khro bcu snying ga nas spro ba dang*/ bdun/ mkha' nang nas sa bon las bskyed de spro ba dang*/

brgyad/ mkha' nang du mi bskyod pa khro bcu dang bcas pa bskyed/ mi bskyod pa spros te rang la bcug pas/ hūṃ mdzad du bsgyur/ hūṃ mdzad kyi rang snang gi rig ma'i mkha' las khro bo bcu spro ba rnams kyang lugs gzhan dang gzhan no/ /dgu/ 'dir bsrung ba'i don tsam du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad mi bsgom pa gtso bo dang*/ steng 'og gi khro bo zhal phyag gzhan du bshad pa yang yod de/ bcu/ de'i phyir rnam pa du ma yod do/ /'di rnams dang*/ 'di dang mthun pa rnams kyang rgyas pa'o rdzogs phreng dang*/ man ngag snye ma'i/ snye ma nyer bdun par bshad pa'i khro bo'i zhal phyag rnams ni/ mngon brjod kyi lugs yin par snang na yang*/ da lta bod du 'gyur ba'i mngon brjod rnams dang mi mthun pa ni dpe gzhan zhig yod par mngon/ man ngag snye ma'i rdor sems sgrub thabs kyi bsrung 'khor yang rgyas pa yin no/ /bcu gcig lū bcu gnyis nag gi bcu gsum/ sgrub thabs kyi srung 'khor dang*/ phag mo mngon 'byung dang*/ bcu bzhi/ snye ma nyer bdun pa'i srung 'khor dang*/ bco lnga/ de rnams dang mthun pa/ 'di ltar khro bo bcu kho na bsgom pa dang*/ bcu drugaphur gdab dang rwa gur tsam byed pa ste/ rwa gur sngon ma dang*/ phur gdab phyis byed pa dang*/ bcu bdun/ phur gdab kyi rjes su rwa gur byed pa rnams ni 'bring po'o/ /bco brgyad/ sngags drug gis byin gyis rlabs pa'i rwa gur tsam byed pa dang*/ bcu dgu/ hūṃ bzhi pas skad cig gis rwa gur grub pa dang*/ nyi shu/ de dang mthun pa rnams ni bsdus pa yin no/ /de la bsrung ba'i 'khor lo 'di ni/ dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i skabs las gzhan du bya dgos pa'i gsal kha mi snang la/ phyir bzlog ni gtso bor gzhan gyi byad ma bzlog pa'i drag shul gyi sbyor ba yin pas/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la 'grub na ches legs mod/ ma 'grub kyang rung ngo*/ /paṇḍi ta chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyi zhal snga nas/

rdo rje phreng bar dkyil 'khor la chu rdol la sogs pa'i gnod pa bsrung ba la yang 'di gsungs so/ /de ltar shes pa na lhag pa'i skyon med cing*/ shin tu rgyas pa yang byar yod la/ skabs med pa'i tshe/ shin tu bsdus pa byas kyang dgos pa'i cho ga ma chad pa zhig 'ong ba yin no/ /lū nag gi lugs gnyis dang*/ dril bu lhar lngar gsungs pa'i don gtsug nor du bshad pa ste/ rtsa gcig /de gsum po grags che bas ma bris so/ /gnyis pa khro bo bsnyen pa ni/ thun mong ba'i srung 'khor yan chad bsgoms te/ chos 'byung gi nang du/ 'byung bzhi ri rab gzhal yas khang mngon byang lnga las rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ de zhu ba glus bskul te khro bo hūṃ mdzad zhal gsum par bskyed/ go cha bgo sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes dgug gzhug bya/ sems dpa' gsum brtsegs bsgom/ dbang bskur te mi bskyod pa'i cod pan bya/ de rnams sbyor ba'o/ /yum gyi gnas lnga byin gyis rlabs/ khro bo bcu mkha' spro sngar srung 'khor du bstan pa bzhin byas te/ ye shes dgug gzhug dang dbang bskur bya/ mchod bstod bya ste/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog go /de nas bzlas pa bya ste rjes kyi bya ba rnams bya'o/ /'di ni nag po'i zhabs kyi man ngag sbyar ba yin la/ gcig / lha thams cad mngon byang lnga las bskyed la/ go cha/ ye shes dbang bskur rgyas btab bya ba lo i pa'i man ngag dang sbyar ba ste/ 'di gnyis nā ro ta pa'i man ngag las 'byung*/ gnyis/ mngon brjod kyi rgyud kyi dngos bstan ni bsrung 'khor dngos bstan de nyid bsgom nas bzlas pa byas la/ rjes kyi cho ga bya ba ste/ khro bo tsam gyi bsnyen pa ni de kho nas rung la/gsum/ snga ma ni bde mchog khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs yin pas/ thun mong gi cho ga lū nag gam/ de dang mthun pa rnams dang thun mong ste de'i phyir de gnyis su rig par bya'o/

/yang gzhan rnams dang po dang 'dra ba las/ rdor sems hūṃ mdzad du bsgyur lugs mngon brjod kyi dngos bstan ltar byed pa'i lugs kyang yod do/ /bzhi/ yang 'khor lo'i lte bar hūṃ mdzad gcig pu bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhis bskyed pa dang*/ khro bo gzhan bcu po la yang yan lag bzhis bskyed kyi sgrubs thabs bod 'ga' zhig gis mdzad la/ lnga/ 'di gzhan gyis rgyas bkab pa ste rung mod/ 'on kyang 'dir khro bo lhag ma rnams kyi las tshogs thun mong ma yin pa sgrub tshul mang po mi snang bas re zhig nye bar mkho ba chen po mi snang ngo*/ /de bzhin du hūṃ las phur bu'i khro bo sgom ste/ 'di'i sgrub thabs kyang cho ga mngon byang lngas bskyed dang*/ gcig zhu ba glus bskul gyi tshul gyis sngar khro bo'i bsnyen pa ltar bskyed pa yin no/ /'di la lha snam gyi dbus su padma 'dab brgyad/ dbus su gtso bo/ lho nub tu las byed kyi phur bu sgom pa yin la/ khwa gdong la sogs pa sgo bzhir sgom la/ glang gdong sogs me la sogs pa gsum du 'god/ gtso bo zhal nub bstan no/ /zhes kha cig 'dod cing*/ 'ga' zhig glang gdong sogs gtso bo'i gnas gsum du 'god mod/ lugs dang po ltar 'thad la/ 'on kyang lho nub kyi phur bu mi dgos so snyam mo/ /sngags ni/ oṃ gha gha/ sogs dang*/ oṃ ki lī ki lā ya hūṃ zhes sogs/ hūṃ mdzad zhal brgyad pa'i ni/ gtso rkyang kho na ste/ chos 'byung du/ padma la sa bon las bskyed de/ 'grel pa ltar mthar/ yan lag bzhi bskyed bya/ bzlas pa'i skabs su khro bo bzhi spro ba yin no/ /de yang khro bo hūṃ mdzad kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa las tshogs sgrub pa la bde mchog nyid kyi dkyil 'khor gyi bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs pa grub pas ni/ hūṃ mdzad kyi sgos bsnyen mi dgos so/ /bsnyen pa'i grangs ni 'bum phrag bzhir sngon gyi bod rnams gsungs la/ dpal he ru ka'i bsnyen pa grub pas hūṃ mdzad kyi bzlas pa khri byas nas las sgrub bo zhes dam pa snga ma rnams 'doms par mdzad do/

/'dir dpyad par bya ba ni 'di yod de/ gang la la hūṃ mdzad kho na rnal 'byor ting nge 'dzin gsum dang*/ yan lag bzhi sogs kyis mi sgrub na des sngags kyi grangs tsam rdzogs pas bsnyen par 'gyur ram/ dpal sangs rgyas thod pa la sogs pa gzhan zhig gis bsnyen pa ni byas la/ rgyud 'dir ma yin pas hūṃ mdzad kyi bzlas pa khri yis las sgrub bam/ 'on te ma yin zhe na/ bskyed pa'i rim pa yongs su ma rdzogs pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor gyis ni/ rdza rnga bcings pa la sogs pa sngags de kho na'i las 'grub pa ni yod la/ gzhan ni ma yin zhing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi las mtha' dag la yang mi dbang la sems kyi dri ma sbyangs pa'ang stobs chung bas/ de ni 'bras bu che ba ma yin la/ gang bskyed rim yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgo nas bsnyen pa grub pas ni/ de dag rgya chen po 'grub pas na/ dpal he ru ka'i bskyed rim yongs su rdzogs pa dang 'brel pa'i bsnyen pa ni gal che la/ de ltar ma yin na rgyud 'dir dbang bskur ba/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud gzhan gyi bsnyen pa legs par grub pas kyang rung ste/ de la 'dir khro bo rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa sngar bstan pa ni/ bskyed rim yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /'o na/ 'dir thig le'am phra mo sgom pa ni ji lta bu zhe na/ sngar bstan pa'i rjes su dkyil 'khor gyi lha ma lus pa spro bsdu'i sbyor bas/ rmi lam lta bur bsam pa'i las rgyal po mchog sgom mo/ /de nas lte snying mgrin spyi'i mdud pa'i bu gar a hūṃ oṃ haṃ/ gsang ba'i 'khor lo'i rlung gis me bskul bas gtum mo'i rang bzhin aṃ 'bar ba'i mes haṃ zhu/ des yi ge gsum gang*/ aṃ dang dbyer med lhan skyes kyi thig ler gyur pa las/ 'od zer gyi re kha phra mo me lce gcig tu 'bar ba lta bu de'i mthus bdud rtsi 'dzag pa'i thig les re kha bsil bar gyur pa/ sems brtan pa'i mtshan ma thob kyi bar du sgom mo/

/mtshan ma rnams kyi nye bar dmigs pas brtan par shes na/ re kha'i 'od kyis thams cad gsal bar byas pa sgom ste/ thig le'i rnal 'byor ro/ /yang na snying ga'i sngags kyi/ 'od kyis 'gro ba thams cad sangs rgyas su byas nas/ nang du 'dus pa thig le'i rnam pa'i hūṃ du gyur pa las yid bzhag go /dbugs 'byin pa na spro/ rngub pa na bsdud pa yang yang sgom mo/ /'dis bying rgod kyang sel lo/ /bsdu ba'i mthar thig le gcig pu dang*/ spro bsdu ji tsam du byas pa de tsam gyi dkyil 'khor yang bsam mo/ /de las gzhan yang ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i 'od dhu tī nas song bas spyi bo'i haṃ zhu ba'i 'bar 'dzag la gtso bor snying gar yid 'jog pa de/ thig le'i rnal 'byor ro/ /phra mo'i rnal 'byor ni sems brtan par byed pa'i thabs dam pa'o zhes pas aṃ la sogs pa yi ge thams cad zhu ba'i thig le yungs 'bru tsam par dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa rdo rje nor bu'am/ de las 'phros pa'i padma'i sna rtser bsam la brtan na dkyil 'khor spro'o/ /yang snying ga'i sngags kyi 'od kyis bkug pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa zhal du zhugs zhu ba'i thig le padma'i sna rtser bsgom pa yang ste phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas ni/ rdza rnga bcing pa'i nges don gyi rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang mthun pa bskyed rim rdo rje'i bzlas pa'o/ /rnam pa 'di gsum ni yan lag gzhan gyi mthu las rdzogs pa'i rim par yang 'gyur te/ gang du phra thig dang rdo rje'i bzlas pa mi gsal ba'i rgyud thams cad du yang 'di sbyar ro/ /zhes pa ni mkhas pa rnams kyi lugs te/ rdo rje slob dpon ye shes zhabs la sogs pa'i man ngag go

/de la 'dir/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa thams cad kyang blang du rung mod/ 'on kyang gtso bo ni mdo li'i bzlas pa yin te/ de skad du/ 'khor lo'i sbyor bdag nyid kyis 。zla/ /dngos grub kun gyi 'bras bskyed pa'o/ /zhes pa'i 'khor lo'i sbyor ba ni mdo li'i bzlas par sngon gyi bla ma mkhas pa rnams 'chad pa ltar don la'ang gnas pa'o/ /gsum pa bris pa'i phyir zlog gi sbyor ba ni/ 'di ltar yin te/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa la gnas pa'i padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje ste/ 'khor lo ni pad 'dab kyi phyi rol du rtse mo 'bur tsam thon pa'i re kha bri'o/ /rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ gi nang du baṃ/ baṃ gyi nang du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ che ge mo/ rakshaṃ ku ru oṃ āḥhūṃ/ shar rwa dbus ma la/ ṛ ḍāṃ de ṛṃ/ byang ṝṃ laṃ de ṝṃ/ nub tu l̥ṃkhaṃ de l̥ṃ/ lhor l̥̄ṃ raṃ de l̥ṃ/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar nas lhor hūṃ khaṃ praṃ de hūṃ hūṃ maṃ tsaṃ de hūṃ hūṃ kaṃ praṃ de hūṃ hūṃ biṃ maṃ de hūṃ/ me nas dbang ldan du/ hūṃ suṃ biṃ/ de hūṃ hūṃ aṃ khaṃ de hūṃ hūṃ baṃ laṃ de hūṃ hūṃ baṃ druṃ de hūṃ/ de'i phyi rol khor yug gnyis kyi bar du/ sngar gyi rim pas/ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ dang*/ ngaṃ tsaṃ tshaṃ dzaṃ ngo*/ de'i phyi rol sna tshogs rdo rje rwa dbus ma rnams la shar nas g.yas bskor gyis/ hūṃ bzhi pa'i rkang pa re re bkod pa hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi bar du ming bcugade'i phyi rol khor yug gnyis kyi bar du shar nas g.yon skor gyis ā li bcu gnyis klad kor can bya/ de'i phyi rol pad 'dab bcu drug la shar nas g.yon skor gyi dbyangs bcu drug zla phyed thig le can/ phyi rol khor yug gnyis kyi bar du g.yon bskor gyis he ru ka'i yig brgya bri/ de'i phyir 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcu drug la shar nas g.yon bskor gyis/ aṃ aiṃ/

baṃ maṃ/ maṃ pāṃ/ baṃ suṃ/ suṃ shyāṃ/ baṃ suṃ/ maṃ haṃ/ biṃ khaṃ/ maṃ tsaṃ/ raṃ khaṃ/ haṃ shoṃ aṃ tsaṃ/ heṃ suṃ/ paṃ maṃ/ beṃ tsaṃ/ baṃ maṃ/ sa bon gnyis tshan gnyis tshan pa oṃ dang hriḥspel ba ste/ oṃ hrīḥ.aṃ aiṃ deṃ hrīḥ.oṃ la sogs pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol khor yug gnyis kyi dbus su g.yon skor phyi/ dzhiṃ nyaṃ ṭaṃ/ ṭhaṃ ṭaṃ dhaṃ ṇaṃ/ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ paṃ phaṃ baṃ bhaṃ/ de'i phyi ru gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsig pa rkyang pa bya/ sgo mtshams su hūṃ phaṭa yaṃ kaṃ yaṃ de hūṃ phaṭa/ de bzhin du hūṃ phaṭa spel ba'i raṃ uṃ raṃ/ laṃ shwaṃ laṃ/ waṃ suṃ waṃ/ shaṃ yaṃ shaṃ ṣaṃ yaṃ ṣaṃ/ saṃ yaṃ saṃ/ haṃ yaṃ haṃ rnams bkod/ de rnams ming la skor bar bya/ sgo'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga phyed zur gyi steng du zla nyi phyed pa'i steng du rdo rje phyed pa/ rdo rje brgyad po'i rwa dbus ma la sngar gyi rim pas rkang pa brgyad pa bri/ de'i phyi'i khor yug gnyis kyi bar du/ shar nas g.yon bskor gyi phyir bzlog gi sngags rings bri/ de'i phyi rol kṣas skor/ de'i phyir ṭhas skor/ de'i phyi rol ā lis skor/ de'i phyi rol kā lis skor/ 'di la kha cig phyir zlog yi ge re re kṣa'i nang du bcug pa de yang ṭha'i nang du chud par bya zhes gsung ngo*/ /de'i phyi rol bde mchog gi rtsa sngags kyis skor/ de'i phyi rol rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gang rung gis skor nas 'od zer phreng ba bri/ 'di la sambhu ṭi ltar na gong gi hūṃ bzhi pa la rkang pa bzhi pa la auṃ med la/ hūṃ hūṃ swāhā zhes pa yod do/ /de yang rigs ngan nam bram ze mo'am/ rgyal po'i bu mo'i me togaglang po'i khram pa'i chang*/ snyoms 'jug las skyes pa'i khu ba/ gi waṃ/ zhun chen gyi snag tsha rnams rdo rje dang padma'i chus bsdur te/ glang po che'i chang ma rnyed na sing po'o/ /mi lpags sam gro ga'am ras la bri ste/ bde mchog zhi khro gang rung gi bdag mdun lha'i rnal 'byor/

gtor ma 'bul ba rnams byas la/ 'byung po'i gtor ma btang*/ kha shar du bltas la bri gzhi la gi waṃ gur gum tsandan la sogs pas byug go /gal te bsad zlog lta bu drag shul la ni/ dug dang khrag dang ke tshe dang*/ nim pa dang*/ lan tsha dang*/ dgra bo'i rjes kyi rdul dang*/ de'i rdo rje'i chu bsris pas byug go /las gzhan rnams la spyi dang mthun pa'i cho ga sbyor ro/ /de nas las dang mthun pa'i smyug gu'am/ pir gyis legs par bris nas/ kha nub tu bstan nas rab gnas bya'o/ /rab gnas ni bgeg bskrad/ khrus bya/ khro bo bcu gcig bskyed pa'am/ ji ltar bris pa bskyed/ sa bon rnams lha de dag dang*/ phyir zlog gi 'bru re re zhing 'khor los sgyur ba/ gzhan rnams kyang he ru ka'i ngo bor mos pa las/ 'khor lo ji lta bu'i ye shes dgug gzhug dbang bskur/ spyan dbye brtan bzhugs/ mchod bstod byas la/ khro bo bcu gcig bskyed na/ spyan dbye byas ma thag de zhu ba 'khor lo snga ma lhar lta'o/ /de la gtor ma phul la tshogs mchod bya/ de nas sgrub pa na gzhal yas khang gi dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa'i lte ba la hūṃ mdzad sgom/ de yongs su gyur pa las khang brtsegs dang 'khor lo rnam snang gi ngo bo/ bris pa'i yi ge sngar bzhin bskyed/ ye shes pa bcug ming yig rnams de yongs su gyur pa'i sgrub byar ltas la/ yid kyis 'khor lo sgrub byar bcas pa/ kha nas bcug ste zhu ba'i khu ba rnams rdo rje'i lam nas byung*/ lha mo'i pad mar sngar bzhin bskyed pa la/ nang dbang bskur/ de nas sgrub bya la ni/ khro bo rnams dang*/ khyad par bgegs mthar byed kyi tshogs spros pa rnams kyis bsrung ba'i phyir/ phyi nas skor bar bsam/ bdud rtsi lnga dang byang sems kyi lus gang bde bas khyab/ sngags kyi 'od las byung ba'i/ lha dkar po bum pa bdud rtsi'i dkar pos gang ba thogs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur zhing*/

mnyam par sbyar bas zhu ba'i khu bas kyang dbang bskur bzhin par bsam ste dpa' bo'i rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ hrīḥha ha che ge mo la shintaṃ rakṣaṃ ku ru ku ru hūṃ sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa dang*/ uṣti ṣa brgya rtsa zla zhing*/ de nas sngags 'don bzhin pas gru bzhir ltab der/ skud pa dkar pos 'khor los mi mngon par dum dkri/ de nyid mgrin pa'am dpung par gdags pas kyang*/ rdo rje lha mos byin gyis rlobs cing bgegs med par byed pa dang*/ g.yul du yang rgyal bar 'gyur zhes gsungs la/ 'on kyang gdon drag po dang byad ma bzlog pa la sgrub pa byed pa gal che ste/ kham phor dkar po'am/ dge ba'i thod par phyi nang gi bdud rtsi lnga/ mar dang sbrang rtsi 'o ma rnams shas che bas bgang*/ der 'khrul 'khor gzhug bkra shis kyi skud pa'i sna ring por bzhag la/ de srin lag gis bzung dgos pas/ snod kha sbyor gyi bar nas bton dgos zhes bla ma rnams gsungs/ bdag bskyed khro bo bcu gcig mdun bskyed khro bo bcu bsgom pa nas bzlas pa'i bar sngar ltar byas la 'khrul 'khor yang bdag bskyed kyi 'khor lo'i lte bar sgom par 'dod/ de nas gzungs thag nas bzungs la sngar gyi dmigs pas bzlas pa bya/ rtse gcig tu de ltar thun bzhi'am/ drug la sogs pas ji srid mtshan ma brtan po ma byung bar du bya ba yin la/ thun 'jog 'khor lo mchod bstod gtor ma phul/ gsol ba gdab pa sogs bya'o/ /nges pa'i rtags mthong na/ 'khor lo phyung la mchod bstod/ dngos grub blang*/ yi ge brgya pa mang du bzlas/ gshegs su gsol te dri bzang gi chus bkru bar bya la/ yang na gshegs su ma gsol bar/ 'o sbrang dang mar dang bdud rtsi lnga bsres pa'i chus bkrus nas gang la gtor ba nad dang ldan pa'ang nad med byed/ ces 'byung*/ de ltar na/ las tshogs kyi mchog zhi ba'i dbang du byas pa'i phyir zlog 'di nye bar mkho bas bris so/

/las gzhan dag la yang spel tshig gi khyad par dang*/ las bzhi'i byed pa so so spyi'i rim pas rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs las 'byung ba ltar bya/ khyad par drag po la hūṃ mdzad kyi rnal 'byor gyis kha sbyor 'byed pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ las sngags oṃ phaṭa che ge bhakṣa ya phaṭa kṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa dang hūṃ phaṭa/ raṃ raṃ raṃ che ge mtshams med pa lnga byed pa raṃ raṃ raṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa'i bzlas pa bzhi khri sogs sngon du song ba dgos so/ /'on kyang*/ de ltar gsungs pa'i cho ga yis/ /yang dag gsung pas gang gsungs pa'i/ /gsod pa de yang rmongs rnams kyi/ /phyin ci log tu brtags byas shing*/ /phyin ci log tu bzung ba 'di/ /sred dang zhe sdang mun sgribs pas/ /skye bo rnams ni bsad byas na/ kha ni thur bstan mnar med 'gro/ /zhes de'i sbyor ba mngon shes med pas mi sgrub par gsungs so/ /bzhi pa la/ thun mong ma yin pa 'khrul 'khor gyi las tshogs dang thun mong ba bsam gtan gyi las/ dang po la 'khrul 'khor bzhi/ de re re la yang las gsum gsum ste/ las chen bcu gnyis sgrub tshul 'khor lo so so'i ming bod kha cig gis/ rdo rje rol pa rta'i 'gros/ /yi dwags srin po gdong gi 'gros/ /gshin rje ro langs gzugs dang*/ ma mo rigs ldan gyi 'gros zhes gsungs pa dang*/ yang gzhan dag rigs ldan dang rta 'gros gnyis las gshin rje/ yi dwags ro langs srin po gdong rnams gzhan du mi bzhed cing*/ rigs ldan rta 'gros gnyis la gnyis gnyis su mdzad/ rigs ldan gyi 'gros che bas rmongs rings yan lag nyams pa gsum der/ dur khrod kyi ras la khrag dang dug dang ske tshes bris la/ de yang dpa' bo'i thod rlon nam bram ze'i thod pa skam por/ snag tsha dang*/ de rnams bsres la bya rog gi sgro rtsa'am/ rkang gis bri/ dbus kyi le tshe stong pa la sgrub bya'i ming spel tshig dang bcas pa 'dri ste/ de yang rdo rje 'dzin pas bde mchog gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgom la/

hūṃ mdzad kyi nga rgyal gyis 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma sngon du 'gro bas bri'o/ /tshes bcu'am bcu bzhi la sha chen dang khyi dang phag dang khyim bya'i sha'i gtor ma dang sbyin bsreg bya/ gos sngon po gyon/ kha lhor ltas te/ thod pa kha sbyar dug khrag ske tshe'i mar khu/ nim pa rnams kyis bkang bar bcug 'khrul 'khor gyi dbus su sgrub bya bsam la spel tshig dang bcas pa sngags zlos shing*/ lag pas rdo rje bzungs nas brdegs pas 'jigs par byed par bsam/ rigs ldan 'gros shes bya ba ni/ klu rigs ldan gyi 'gros te klu rnams gya gyur 'gro ba lta bu zhes bha ba bha dras bshad cing de yang*/ sbrul 'khyil ba lta bu ste/ che ba 'di ni lho nub kyi zur phyi ma nas g.yas su skor ba tha ma dbus kyi lho'i re mig tu 'byung*/ chung ba la zur bzhi'i re mig dgu dgu la sngags tshar re re rang rang phyogs kyi zur rtse nas g.yas skor tha ma rang rang gi dkyil du 'byung ba 'di ni bla ma bod pa rnams bzhed do/ /'jigs med 'byung gnas kyi zhal snga nas ni rigs ldan che ba mdun nas mgo rtsom par bzhed de tha ma dbus kyi byang du 'ong ba yin no/ /'khrul 'khor bzhi pos bcu gnyis su 'gro ba'ang*/ rdzas dang spel tshig srog gzugs sogs kyis phye ba yin la/ de la bzhi ka'ang*/ gzhal yas khang rtsig rkyang sgo bzhi pa'i nang du bri zhing*/ sna tshogs rdo rje mi byed pa'ang yod mod/ sngags btu ba'i gzhi la de ltar yin mod kyang*/ 'di la gzhal yas khang yod med gdam nga yin zhing*/ sna tshogs rdo rje nges par dgos pas lte ba gru bzhi pa la re mig zhe dgu bya/ sna tshogs rdo rje sna tshogs padma la gnas pa/ phyi rol khor yug gsum gyis skor phaṭa yi sngon du ming spel 'dri bar 'phags yul gyi slob dpon man ngag rigs pa dag bzhed de/ de ltar na spros pas chog go /las gsum po de rnams kyi 'khor lo gang du sba ba ni dur khrod dam ro bsregs pa'i sar ro/

/rigs lngar chung ba ni dbang dgug rmugs pa'i las byed de/ dbang dgug gro ga la gur gul dang*/ gi waṃ dang*/ sdong ros kyis bri/ rmugs pa dur khrod kyi ras la dug dang ske tshe'i khu bas so/ /'di la hūṃ gnyis kyi bar du gzir ba'i le tshe stong pa la sgrub bya'i ming dang spel tshig go /dbang dgug la bram ze'i thod par gzhug sba mi dgos rmugs pa la g.yul du bsad pa'i thod pa dur khrod du sba/ rta 'gros che ba ni/ zur gyi re mig dgu dgu la mgo rang rang gi bden bral nas brtsams mjug rlung du 'ong ba ni/ dbus kyi re mig sogs la 'gyog por 'phyong ba der/ srin dbang me dang chu gnod sbyin/ gshin rje dang ni rlung du'o/ /re mig stong pa bcu bdun du ming spel bya/ 'di la snga ma rnams phaṭa mi dgod la/ hūṃ gnyis te re mig gcig tu bri/ phaṭa kyang 'god ces lugs gzhan no/ /'dis bsad skrad dbye gsum ro ras la dug khrag ske tshe rnams kyis bri/ bris gzhi srog gzugs ni bsad pa la yi dwags gshin rje dang ro langs gang rung snod thod pa mtshan ngan/ skrad pa rnga mo'am ma he/ dbye ba la rta dang ma he/ snod kyang de dag gi thod pa dang*/ de nas dur khrod dam dgra'i sgor gnon/ rta 'gros chung ba ni/ re mig dgu dgu rang rang gi zur nas mgo rtsom/ re mig re re bor ba'i spel ma/ 'di la ming spel gyi gnas sum cu so gsum mo/ /'di'i las ni/ phur gdab/ ma ning*/ gzugs brje ba gsum ste/ ro ras la khrag sogs kyis bri/ lam gyi bzhi mdor sba'o/ /thog mar sngags btus te/ de nas bris gzhi la spo/ de nas lhar bskyed pa sogs kyi rab gnas bya/ de nas dkris te snod du sgrub pa dang sba ba sogs bya ste/ thun mong ba rnams gshin rje gshed ltar bya'o/ /gzhal yas khang byed pa sogs 'di rnams rdo rje mkha' 'gro ltar yin zhing*/ saṃ bhu ṭi dang gzhan du rdza rnga'i dbyibs kyi 'khor lo bya bar gsungs/

de yang kha sbyor gyi lugs la ni/ 'dir bstan 'khor lo dang po gcig pu la/ so so rdzas dang spel tshig sogs kyis dbye ba ste/ snye ma nyer bdun par/ 'dir ni 'khor lo 'di ltar dgod pa kho nas/ gnon pa dang bcing pa zhes sogs bshad do/ /rgyud du 'khor lo gcig las ma bshad pas 'di legs pa yin te/ de yang 'khor lo'i gtso bo yang rnam dag la sogs pa'i nges pa las na/ rigs ldan gyi 'gros che bar grags pa gtso bor snang la/ 'khor lo gcig nyid kyis las kun sgrub pa ni/ de nyid las/ 'khor lo rdza rnga'i dbyibs su gyur pa/ rdo rje dang padmas mtshan pa/ sku rdo rje la sogs pa bsdus nas phyi rol du ri mo gsum gyis bskor te las kyi rdo rje rab tu sgoms pas dgra thams cad nges par gnon zhing*/ las thams cad byed do zhes gsungs so/ /'dir ni sa bcad tsam smos kyi rgyas par rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rab byed dgu pa las shes so/ /rgyud der sngags btu ba na/ ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ bor pa'i dbyangs bcu gnyis la/ 'phel ba/ gti mug /bzang po/ khyu mchog rus sbal/ chu srin/ yugs sa mo/ rme ba/ 'bugs pa/ 'phyo ba/ rmi lam/ sa yi dbang phyug zhes ming ni brda sbyar bar go bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa bsam gtan gyi las ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor/ ā li kā li'i don gyi las tshogs ji snyed pa de dag ste/ rtsa rgyud du sngags btu ba'i gzhi ā li kā li'i dkyil 'khor bshad pa'i don 'chad pa ste/ phal cher sngags kyi byed las bshad pa yin zhing*/ dkyil 'khor mi 'dra yang yi ge 'dra ba'i phyir sngags btu rnams kyi thun mong yin par rig go

/ 'di dag bshad rgyud de gnyis 'grel pa dang bcas par blta'o/ /'dir ha cang mang bar 'gyur bas bzhag go /lnga pa la rdza rnga'i bcings pa'i nges don/ bsrung bzlog gi sbyor ba'i nges don/ skabs 'dir 'brel ba'i rdzogs rim sil bu sna tshogs pa'o/ /dang po gnyis ni skabs kyi don du snang bas 'dir 'chad la/ phyi ma ni ā li kā li'i las tshogs kyi bar bar na yi ge'i nang gi bshad pa rdzogs rim mang du yod pa de dag yin pas bshad rgyud de dag tu rtogs par bya'o/ /dang po la/ sngags kyi nges don dang*/ las kyi nges don te/ sngags btus zin pa'i nang bshad gnyis dang*/ rdza rnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi nges don nam/ sngags btu bar bya ba dang*/ 'thu bzhin pa'i nang bshad de gsum las/ dang po ni hūṃ bzhi pa'i hūṃ gi mtshon don mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba yin te/ bde stong nam mkha'i mthas klas pa'i brtan g.yo kun la mnyam pa nyid kyis khyab pa ni/ gnas te 'dod sred med pa'i shes rab kyi cha nā das mtshon la/ cha gzugs kun zhes pa la cha thig le ste/ thig le dang bcas pa'i hūṃ yig gis ni thig le 'pho med kyi ngo bo rang rig bde ba dang*/ phyi nang gi hūṃ de gnyis lha thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po kun tu 'byung ba'am/ gyur pa'i sa bon te grub pa'i slob dpon karma li'i zhal snga nas/ kun tu gyur pa'i sa bon ni/ /yi ge hūṃ gi cha gzugs can/ /mi 'gyur ba ni bde ba ste/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam gnas med pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni go cha bcings pa ste/ de yang phyogs bcing pa la sogs pa'i bsrung ba'o/ /'di la shes rab dang thabs kyi cha gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thams cad stong pa 'od gsal ba yang yin la/ brten te rdul phra rab med pa'i lha sku'i dkyil 'khor yang yin pa/ des gnyis snang dang gnyis 'dzin thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i tshul gyis bsrung ba'o/ /de yang de nyid kyis/ de nas go cha bcing byas nas/

/thams cad stong pa rten med pa/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa thabs kyi cha ni rgyud gzhan gdan bzhi la sogs pa dang*/ mngon spyod bzhi pa las/ byams pa'i go cha bgos pa ste/ /snying rje yi ni go cha bgos/ /shes rab mtshon cha bsgom ldan pas/ /nyon mongs bdud las nges rgyal 'gyur/ /'dir shes rab ni stong nyid rtogs pa yin la/ mtshon cha ni rdo rje'i ra ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rtsa rgyud sum cu pa las/ de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /shin tu rnyed dka' dgod pa ste/ /gang gis shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /myur du dngos grub sgrub byed pa/ /sa yi cha mnyam yid 'ong bar/ /tsandan gyis ni nye bar bku/ /dri bzang dri ldan sa la ni/ /me tog sil ma bcal bkram zhing*/ /spos kyi dri yis nyams dga' bar/ /bdag gi bya ba byas nas ni/ /phyogs bcing pa yang byas nas su/ /de nas rdza rnga bcing byas te/ /ri mo dgu yis legs par bskor/ /yi ge phyi mo mnyam bris la/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag dgod par bya/ /der gnas pa las dpa' bo ni/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub byed pa/ /rim bzhin 'byung dang rim min pas/ /dbyangs dang yi ge sgrub pa pos/ /grangs de dag gi nang chud pa/ /dge ba thub par byas nas ni/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di nges don te/ 'di la gnyis/ sa gzhi yi nges don dang*/ re mig gi nges don no/ /dang po ni/ dngos grub sgrub byed zhes pa la/ las dang dngos grub sngar bstan pa ltar/ 'khrul 'khor dang bsam gtan gyis sgrub ces gsungs/ 'dir ni man ngag gi rim pa phyir zlog brgyad kyis mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub ces bya'o/ /sa yi chu mnyam pa dkyil 'khor gru bzhi 'bar 'bur med pa'i nges don/ chos thams cad bden gnyis yul sems rang gzhan don gnyis/ spang blang/ phan gnod/ 'khor 'das rnams rang bzhin mnyam nyid yin pa ma rtogs par byis pas sdug bsngal ba thob la/ rnal 'byor pas man ngag las 'byung ba ltar mnyam pa nyid bsgom pas/

rang bzhin de mngon du 'gyur bas/ de'i tshe zung 'jug ces bya'o/ /tsandan ni tshul khrims te/ de yang sems gnyis snang 'dzag bcas kyi tshe rang bzhin stong par rtogs pa'i 'dzag med kyi tshul khrims te/ bsil bar byed pas tsandan dang mtshungs pa yin la/ de yang*/ tshul khrims tsandan gyis lus byugs/ /bsam gtan gyis ni gos dag gyon/ /byang chub yan lag me tog bkram/ /zhes 'byung ngo*/ /dri zhim po'i dris byugs pa'i sa ni zhu bde'i byang chub kyi sems 'pho med du bcings pa'i bde ba stong par sbyor bas rlan pa'i sems te rgyud gzhan las/ bde ba chen po'i nam mkhar gnas/ byang chub sems ni sad pa dang*/ de nyid kyis kyang byug pa ni/ zhes te/ nam mkha' ni rang bzhin gyis stong pa dang*/ sad pa ni gyen du bcings pa'i ming ngo*/ /me tog bdun ni/ padma/ utpal/ dzā ti/ karṇi ka ma li ka yu thi ka kā ra bī ra te/ de yang byang chub yan lag bdun mtshon pa yin te/ 'phags lam yan lag 'bras bu dang mtshungs pa/ de dngos su 'byin pas na me tog lta bu zhes pa thun mong ngo*/ /thun mong ma yin pa kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyis mthong ba'i lam lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni/ byang chub yan lag bdun te/ me tog bsil ma'o/ /gzhan yang*/ yang dag dga' ba'i me tog gis/ /rdo rje nyi ma padmar phyung*/ /me tog bdag nyid la mchod pa/ /rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid mchog/ces gsungs te/ zhu bde'i lhan skyes kyi dga' ba rdo rje nor bur mngon du gyur pa ni/ gsal zhing mdzes pas yang dag dga' ba'i me tog ces bya la/ nyi ma ni shes rab ma'i me tog ste/ khrag gi dwangs ma padma'i lte bar phyung ba/ bdag nyid kyis dhu tīs btung bar bya ste/ 'di las gang zhig thob na/ khu khrag rlung gsum dag pas dwangs ma'i 'ja' lus sems dang dbyer med pa mngon du 'gyur te/ de ltar na sems de bzhin nyid la 'jug pa 'dod chags chen pos sgrub pa mthar phyin pas rig pa'i skyes bu mngon du byed tshul dang*/

phyag rgya'i lam la dang por slob pas kyang*/ 'di'i lam dang mthun pa zhig dgos shing*/ nus mthu de lta bu tshang pa'i bud med kyi rang byung ni 'dir me tog go /de ltar me tog gi nges don gsum ga la'ang ji bzhin ma yin pa'i sgra ste/ rim pas spyi don dang*/ mthar thug dang*/ sbas don rnams gtso che'o/ /spos kyi dri ni/ de skad du/ rnam rtog tshogs kyi yul min zhing*/ lte bar gtum mo'i me yis ni/ /nges par bsregs pa de yis spos/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rnam rtog gi rtsol ba la ma ltos pa'i gtum mo ye shes kyi mes phung po sogs bsregs pa'i bde ba ste/ 'di yang mthong ba'i lam yan chad du mngon du 'gyur la drod thob pa na yang rjes mthun pa ni mngon du byed nus so/ /gzhan yang spyi don gyi nges don 'di dag ste/ mngon brjod bzhi par/ mnyam pa'i sems ni dri yin te/ /gru bzhi pa ni byug pa yin/ /lus dang te'u dang tsandan ni/ /mnyam par gnas pa nyid yin no/ /me tog bzod pa rnal 'byor pa/ /'bad pas gtor ba yin par bshad/ /rang bzhin dag pa mar me ste/ /mnyam nyid bsgom pa gdug pa nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ mnyam pa'i sems kyi dri/ dngos po thams cad la byug pa zhes sbyar te/ byams pa dang sdang ba rang bzhin med pas mnyam par bsgom pa dang*/ bzod pa yang bde sdug dang yangs dog sogs rang bzhin med pas bzod pa ste/ gang rang bzhin med par shes pas snang ba thams cad mnyam par bzod do/ /chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa snang ba dang stong pa res 'jog ma yin par rtogs pa ni mar me dang*/ de'i phyir 'khor ba rang bzhin mnyam par bsgom pa bdug spos zhes brdar brtags pa ste/ 'di dag ni man ngag dam pa rigs pas rtsa bshad sbyar ba'o/ /bdag gi bya ba hūṃ yig dang phyogs bcing ba go cha ste/ gong du bshad pa de'o/ /gzhan yang 'di yod de/ mar me dang*/ bshos kyi nges don thabs kyi rgyud las 'di ltar 'byung ba yang 'di'i don yin te/

yi ge hūṃ las yang dag byung*/ /sngags kyi 'od zer shin tu gsal/ /mar me 'bar ba'i yang dag 'od/ /sngags kyi 'od zer ni rlung bcu po rnams te/ 'od zer gyi rnam par snang ba dang*/ sngags kyi de nyid du/ rang bzhin gyis gnas pa'i phyir/ de ni 'gyur med hūṃ ste snying ga'i thig le dang*/ mi shigs pa'i sems las 'byung la/ khams kyi sgrod pa der zad pa na/ yang dag pa'i 'od gsal 'char ba ni bdag gi bya ba ste/ snying ga'i thig le'am/ rnam par shes pa ni bdag ces bya'o/ /'dir ni gang dang gang longs spyod/ /dbang po thams cad yang dag brten/ /de dag thams cad thugs rdo rje/ /bza' ba'i mchod pas mchod par bya/ /yul dang dbang po thams cad rang bzhin med pa/ rnam pa thams cad pa'i stong pa'i dkyil 'khor yul dus chad pa med par longs spyod pa'i dbang po thams cad pa ste/ dbang po thams cad rang gar gnas kyang g.yo ba med pa'i man ngag gi ye shes dam pa zhes bya'o/ /'ga' zhig ltar las dang po pa kho nas tshogs drug lhug par 'jog pa ltar ni ma yin te khyad par chen po shes dgos so/ /'di gnyis ni rtsa rgyud kyis gzhung 'di'i don 'chad pa ste/ skabs 'dir mar me sogs kyi ni ma yin no/ /gnyis pa la gnyis las/ ming gi don mu ra dze yi ge gsum gyi sku gsum mtshon zhing*/ chos longs sprul gsum rim pas thugs gsung sku yin la/ de ltar mu ra dze'i sngags ni thugs gsung sku'i sngags te 'bru gsum mo/ /de yang gnyug ma'i sngags te ldang 'jug gnas gsum de gsum gyi gdangs su rang bcas su yod pa de la gnad du bsnun na/ sku gsum mngon du byed pa'i nus pa can yin la/ 'di dngos ni ngag gi chos yin kyang*/ lus ngag sems gsum dbyer med pa'i nges pas/ ngag nyid la'ang sgo gsum gyis rab tu phye ba dang*/ rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin nye bar len pas gnas pa yin te/ de yang lwa ba'i zhabs kyis/

rdza rnga zhes bya ba la yi ge gsum ni sku gsung thugs kyi dbye bas sku gsum mo zhes so/ /gnyis pa re mig gi nges don ni/ de la ri mo brgyad dang dbus kyi ri mo ste dgu'o/ /dbus kyi ri mo ni ri mo brgyad kyi gzhi yin pa bzhin/ snang ba thams cad kyi rtsa ba yang rlung gi dwangs ma mi shigs pa nyid yin la/ de yang dbus kyi ri mos mtshon no/ /de yang rdza rnga'i rnam pa dbus su bkod pas rlung sngags dbyer med par ston pa yin te/ lwa ba pas/ rlung gi shin tu skor ba yi/ /ri mo brgyad pa yang dag brten/ ri mo dgu pa dbus su'o/ /zhes so/ /yi ge phyi mo mnyam pa'i don/ /slob dpon de nyid kyis/ /stong pa'i rnam pa dri med dgod/ /ā li kā li mnyam rgyas bya/ /dbyangs gsal zhe brgyad ste bcu drug tshan gsum ni mnyam pa'i don yin la/ 'og tu dga' ba bzhi'i rang bzhin zhes 'byung ba dang*/ stong pa'i rnam pa zhes pa ni stong pa bcu drug gi gzugs sam mtshon byed dri ma med pa ni/ rang bzhin ngo bo nyid kyis dag pa'i rang bzhin rnam dag gi don no/ /des na stong nyid bcu drug dang*/ dga' ba bcu drug sbyar ba'i bde stong gi ye shes 'di rnams re re la snying rje gsum gsum du dbye bas bcu drug tshan gsum ste dmigs pa med pa bcu drug dbyangs dang*/ lhag ma gsal byed de/ bde chen thugs rje'i bdag nyid can zhes pa'i nges pa'o/ /de nas dbus kyi yi ge 'chad pa na/ rnga'i don slar yang bshad de/ dga' ba bzhi yi rang bzhin can/ /chos kyi rnga chen mi shigs pa/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi rnga dang*/ lus kyi dbus snying ga'i mi shigs pa'i rnga'o/ /dga' bzhi'i rang bzhin can ni dga' ba bzhi 'byung ba can no/ /re mig stong pa'i rnam pa can la/ yi ge re re mnyam par bkang ba ni/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis pa'i/ chos kyi yi ge yongs rdzogs pa/ chos kyi rnga dbyangs gsal gyi bdag nyid gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi chos rdzogs par ston pa mtshon la/

ngag gi bya ba thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni mi shigs pa'i rlung yin zhing*/ de ni yi ge zhe brgyad po'i rten kṣas mtshon no/ /gong du rnga'i ming dang*/ 'dir don bshad do/ /grangs de dag gi nang chud dang*/ /zhes pa'i don/ grangs de dag gi nang son par/ /chos bdag med la yang dag brten/ /dbyangs gsal las sngags mthu ba ni/ /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi/ /dbyangs gsal gyi snying po bdag med pa'i ye shes mthu ba'o/ /zhal bzhi par ni rnam grags pa/ bdud bzhi rnam par 'joms pa po/ de ltar btus zin pa'i sngags kyis bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i don dga' bzhi'i bde stong gi ye shes kyis bdud bzhi 'joms pa'o/ /rlung la zhon nas spro byed cing*/ khams gsum po ni yang dag bsdud/ rlung gi de nyid yang dag rig/sumbha'i sngags zla ba'i tshe spro bsdu byed pa ni/ khams gsum pa'i rtsa ba rlung gi de nyid rig nas/ rlung la rdor bzlas byed pa ste/ yi ge dang rlung dbyer med pa sngar bstan pa ltar ro/ /de dag ni/ 'dod pa'i don kun sgrub byed pa/ /zhes pa'i don te/ rim bzhin 'byung dang rim min pa'i/ /ā li kā li las byung ba/ /brjod dang rjod bya'i yi ge ste/ /sgra snyan lta bu'i rnam par rtogs/ /'di la gnyis/ brjod bya la sbyar na ā li kā li rim dang rim min gyis mthu ba'i don dga' bzhi lugs 'byung lugs ldog go /ā li kā lis ni khams dkar dmar gnyis mtshon la/ des na bde ba ni dkar dmar 'dus pa las byung ba'o/ /rjod byed la sbyar ba ni/ 'dir bkod pa ni yi ge min gyi yi ge'i brda'i gzugs yin pa ltar des ni ngag thams cad brag cha lta bu'o/ /zhes bstan zhing nang gi sbyor bas rlung thams cad mi shigs pa dang*/ stong pa la thim pas sgra nam mkha' dang mnyam pa gang yin pa ste/ de ltar na/ mi shigs pa'i rdor zlas kyis drangs pa'i dga' ba bzhi'i lhan skyes kyi bde chen dang*/

bdag med kyi don sbyar zhing bsgom pa 'di ni rdza rnga'i re mig la dbyangs gsal bkod nas sngags thu ba'i nges don no/ /gnyis pa bsrung zlog gi sbyor ba'i nges don la/ bsrung ba dang phyir zlog gnyis kyi dang po la/ rtsa rgyud le'u gnyis pa las/ rwa ba rnams ni phyogs su dgod/ /'og tu yang ni mtshon cha dgod/ /'khor lo'i bdag nyid mtshon cha mnyam/ /steng du mda'i drwa ba bya/ /de ltar bdag nyid mkha' spyod du/ /gur byas 'di ni go char 'gyur/ /zhes pa la rgyud gzhan nas gsal bar gsungs pa'i nges pa ni sbyin pa'i rwa ba byin par bya/ steng du tshul khrims drwa ba'o/ /bzod pa'i phur bu 'og tu gdab ces pas/ gzung 'dzin las grol ba'i gnyis med ye shes dang ldan pa/ chos kyi dang*/ ngo bo thams cad rtsa bzhin gtor ba/ zang zing dang*/ 'gro ba la gnod pa med pa mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa'i rwa ba dang*/ gzhan la gnon pa 'gog pa'i tshul khrims gsum ni/ gur dang mda' dra/ bzod pa gsum ni phur bu'i sa gzhi ste sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi'o/ /'di ni spyi don yang yin la nges don yang yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ bde ba'i dkyil 'khor bsrung don du/ gdug pa thams cad khyad par gyi/ /'di ni rnyed pa tsam gyis kyang*/ /rtag mi dgos par 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /'khor lo'i sbyor bdag nyid kyis zla/ /dngos grub kun gyi 'bras bskyed pa'o/ /gdug pa ni kun rtog

go /rig rgyal 'khor lo bsgyur ba ste/ rnam par mi rtog pas mtshan 'dzin 'khor los gcod pa ltar gcod pas rtag pa ste/ the tshom med par 'chi ba der 'od gsal du 'gyur la/ dngos grub kun kyang 'dis thob bo/ /mngon brjod las/ phyir zlog chen mo bsrung ba dang*/ rdo rje kha bzhis rnam par mtshan/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yi/ /rim pa gsum pa rdo rjes mtshan/ /thams cad mchog gi bsrung ba che/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu gsol/ /bdud dang bdud min pa yang min/ /rang gi sems ni bcing bar bya/ /rang gi sems ni bcings pa la/ /bdud kyi 'jug pa ga la yod/ /ces pa la/ phyir zlog gi 'khor lo'i rdo rje rtse bzhi pa ni dbang phyug brgyad rdo rje bzhis phye ba dang*/ khor yug gsum ni sku gsum dang rdo rje gsum mo/ /'dir thams cad mchog gi bsrung ba ni/ dngos po thams cad stong par rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis gnyis 'dzin gyi bdud thams cad bcing ba la phyi rol bdud kyi 'jug pa med de/ rang bzhin de la bdud dang*/ bdud min te bar du gcod pa dang mi gcod pa ngo bos grub pa med cing*/ mnyam pa nyid kyis phyir ro/ /de ltar 'dir phyi'i bar chad sngags dang rnal 'byor gyis phyir zlog pa dang*/ 'khrul 'khor gyis phyir zlog pa dang*/ nang gi bar chad rlung gis dang*/ mnyam pa nyid kyis dang*/ ye shes 'khor los zlog pa dang*/ gnyis ka'i la snying rje chen po'i phyir zlog pa dang*/ rig pa'i skad cig gis phyir zlog pa dang*/ 'bras bu la bar chod srid zhi mnyam nyid kyis zlog pa'o/ /de ltar 'di ni zhal gyi gdams pa ste/ man ngag dang ldan pa dag 'doms par mdzad pa gang yin pa de bshad zin to/ /'di dag gi 'thad pa rgyas par rgyud 'grel rnams dang*/ bla ma'i zhabs la brten zhing rtogs par bya la 'dir ni re shig chog go /mchog tu 'jigs byed he ru ka dpal rdo rje khro bo'i sprin spro ba/

/de yi rnal 'byor gsal bar byas pa'i phun tshogs las 'dis 'gro rnams kyi/ /bdud kyi dra ba bcad nas rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'du bar shog/sdom pa'i rgyud rgyal shin tu rgya che'i bsrung ba'i sbyor ba rnam mang po/ /mtha' dag nyung ngu'i tshig gis gsal bar bya'o gzur gnas pa'i/ /mkhas pa'i skye bo rnal 'byor 'dir gnas rnams kyis rol rtsed mdzod/ /bla mar bsnyen bkur byas gang man ngag rnams kyi rin chen mtsho/ /phal cher rgyud sde rgya chen ma mthong mthong na yang*/ /rgya che bsdu bar mi nus gzhan dag ma 'khrul med/ /'ga' zhig man ngag bral te phal cher 'di na nyams/ /ma nor man ngag ldan pas bshad de 'dis kyang blo/ /zab dang rgya che dpog pa min nam rdo rje khro bo yi/ /sgrub thabs yan lag btus 'dis rgyud don dpag med gsal bar gyur/ /bsam gtan rdzun smra rnams la 'di ni shin tu rtsub pa'i sgra/ /gang yang rgyud rig mchog tu dga' bskyed rna ba'i bdud rtsi yin/ /sbyor ba 'di yi yi ge ni/ /gsal po sngon chad ma mthong nas/ /rgyud gzhung 'grel bcas gzhan yang ni/ /phyogs 'di'i rdo rje can mang po/ /kun gyi rim pa'ang mthong ba dang*/ /man ngag ldan phyir phan blos bshad/ /grub pa rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ / 'phags pa rnams kyis 'di nyid mkhyen/ /mang thos mkhas smra mkhas pa'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /rang phyogs rtag par rtag tu 'dzin 'dod pas/ /gya gyu'i blo gros blo ldan 'di dag rnams/ /'di la ci 'dod ci dga' spyod cing rung*/ zhes pa ni bde mchog khro bo rnam par rol pa'i sgrub thabs yan lag rgyas pa dang bcas pa tshig nyung 'di ni/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor pa kun dga' snying po tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer gnyis pa smin drug gi nya ba la grub pa'i gnas bsam gtan sdings su sbyar ba'o// //dge legs 'phel/ shu bha mā stu sarba dzā ga taṃ/ /maṅga laṃ/ /gnyis zhus/
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/'khor lo sdom pa khro bo rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba rdo rje he ru ka'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ -PAGE 244--PAGE 243--PAGE 213-
